campaigns.create.title: Create campaign
campaigns.create.description: Create a Givebutter campaign. Official POST /v1/campaigns requires title and type.

currency.description: Currency code. Only USD is supported.

meta.description: SEO meta tags for the campaign page.

campaigns.update.title: Update campaign
campaigns.update.description: Update a campaign by ID using the official PUT /v1/campaigns/{campaign} endpoint.

currency.description: Currency code. Only USD is supported.

meta.description: SEO meta tags for the campaign page.

campaigns.update.put.title: Update campaign (PUT)
campaigns.update.put.description: Fully replace campaign fields via PUT /v1/campaigns/{campaign}. Path parameter is campaign (integer).

currency.description: Currency code. Only USD is supported.

meta.description: SEO meta tags for the campaign page.

campaigns.delete.title: Delete campaign
campaigns.delete.description: Delete a campaign by ID. The API rejects campaigns that have already raised funds.

campaigns.tickets.create.title: Create campaign ticket
campaigns.tickets.create.description: Create a ticket item on a campaign via POST /v1/campaigns/{campaign}/items/tickets.

scope.description: Ticket scope: registrant (per person) or event (per order).

active.description: Whether the ticket is available for purchase.

bundles.description: Bundle IDs this ticket belongs to.

bundle_only.description: Whether the ticket can only be bought as part of a bundle.

total_quantity.description: Total quantity available. Omit for unlimited.

campaigns.tickets.get.title: Get campaign ticket
campaigns.tickets.get.description: Get one campaign ticket by campaign ID and ticket ID.

campaigns.tickets.list.title: List campaign tickets
campaigns.tickets.list.description: List ticket items for a campaign.

campaigns.discount-codes.create.title: Create discount code
campaigns.discount-codes.create.description: Create a campaign discount code via POST /v1/campaigns/{campaign}/discount-codes.

active.description: Whether the code can be used immediately.

amount.description: Percentage (1-100) or fixed amount in cents.

items.description: Item IDs this code applies to. Omit for all items.

starts_at.description: UTC datetime when the code becomes active (ISO-8601).

expires_at.description: UTC datetime when the code expires (ISO-8601).

campaigns.discount-codes.list.title: List discount codes
campaigns.discount-codes.list.description: List discount codes for a campaign.

campaigns.discount-codes.update.title: Update discount code
campaigns.discount-codes.update.description: Update a campaign discount code via PUT /v1/campaigns/{campaign}/discount-codes/{discountCode}.

active.description: Whether the code can be used immediately.

amount.description: Percentage (1-100) or fixed amount in cents.

items.description: Item IDs this code applies to. Omit for all items.

starts_at.description: UTC datetime when the code becomes active (ISO-8601).

expires_at.description: UTC datetime when the code expires (ISO-8601).

campaigns.discount-codes.delete.title: Delete discount code
campaigns.discount-codes.delete.description: Delete a campaign discount code. Official response is 204.

campaigns.members.list.title: Get members
campaigns.members.list.description: List fundraising members for a campaign (Composio GET_MEMBERS).

campaigns.teams.list.title: Get teams
campaigns.teams.list.description: List fundraising teams for a campaign (Composio GET_TEAMS).

contacts.create.title: Create contact
contacts.create.description: Create a Givebutter contact. Official POST /v1/contacts.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values (id and value pairs).

contacts.update.title: Update contact
contacts.update.description: Update a contact by ID using PUT /v1/contacts/{contact}. Composio requires first and last name.

contacts.update.put.title: Update contact (PUT)
contacts.update.put.description: Replace contact fields via PUT /v1/contacts/{contact}. Path parameter is contact (integer).

contacts.archive.title: Archive contact
contacts.archive.description: Archive (soft-delete) a contact via DELETE /v1/contacts/{contact}. Contact must have no associated gifts.

contacts.restore.title: Restore contact
contacts.restore.description: Restore an archived contact via PATCH /v1/contacts/{contact}/restore.

contacts.activities.list.title: List contact activities
contacts.activities.list.description: List activities for a contact, optionally filtered by type.

contacts.activities.create.title: Create contact activity
contacts.activities.create.description: Log a contact activity (note, call, meeting, etc.).

contacts.activities.get.title: Get contact activity
contacts.activities.get.description: Get one contact activity by contact ID and activity ID.

contacts.activities.update.title: Update contact activity
contacts.activities.update.description: Update a contact activity via PUT /v1/contacts/{contact}/activities/{activity}.

contacts.activities.delete.title: Delete contact activity
contacts.activities.delete.description: Delete a contact activity. Official response is 204.

contacts.tags.add.title: Add contact tags
contacts.tags.add.description: Add tags to a contact via POST /v1/contacts/{contact}/tags/add.

contacts.tags.remove.title: Remove contact tags
contacts.tags.remove.description: Remove tags from a contact via POST /v1/contacts/{contact}/tags/remove.

contacts.tags.sync.title: Sync contact tags
contacts.tags.sync.description: Replace all tags on a contact via POST /v1/contacts/{contact}/tags/sync.

funds.list.title: List funds
funds.list.description: List funds in the authenticated account.

funds.create.title: Create fund
funds.create.description: Create a fund with a name and optional code.

funds.update.title: Update fund
funds.update.description: Update a fund name or code via PUT /v1/funds/{fund}.

households.list.title: List households
households.list.description: List households in the authenticated account.

households.create.title: Create household
households.create.description: Create a household that groups related contacts.

households.delete.title: Delete household
households.delete.description: Delete a household. Official response is 204.

households.contacts.list.title: List household contacts
households.contacts.list.description: List contacts associated with a household.

households.contacts.add.title: Add household contact
households.contacts.add.description: Add a contact to a household via POST /v1/households/{household}/contacts.

transactions.list.title: Get transactions
transactions.list.description: List donations and payments. Composio limit maps to official per_page.

transactions.create.title: Create transaction
transactions.create.description: Record an offline donation via POST /v1/transactions. payment_method is sent as official method.

transacted_at.description: UTC datetime of the gift (ISO-8601, must be in the past).

campaign_code.description: Campaign code to credit. Required if campaign_title is omitted.

campaign_title.description: Campaign title to credit. Required if campaign_code is omitted.

tickets.list.title: Get tickets
tickets.list.description: List issued tickets for the authenticated account (Composio GET_TICKETS).

payouts.list.title: Get payouts
payouts.list.description: List payouts. Composio limit maps to official per_page.

plans.list.title: Get plans
plans.list.description: List recurring donation plans. Composio limit maps to official per_page.

messages.list.title: List messages
messages.list.description: List messages sent through the Givebutter account.

webhooks.list.description: List webhook subscriptions. Composio limit maps to official per_page.

events.description: Event types that trigger this webhook.

webhooks.update.put.description: Replace a webhook subscription via PUT /v1/webhooks/{webhook}. Path parameter is webhook.
